children: Canada asset manager's Q3 revenue fell 10% yr/yr, missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 missed analyst expectations
Company discontinued quarterly dividend to focus on financial flexibility and reducing leverage
Fiera Capital discontinued its quarterly dividend to focus on capital allocation and reducing leverage
Company says market environment remains challenging for active managers
SUB-ADVISED MANDATE OUTFLOWS - Revenue decline was mainly due to lower base management fees from sub-advised mandates and lower performance fees
PUBLIC MARKETS NET OUTFLOWS - AUM fell due to net outflows in public markets, especially sub-advised assets, and adverse market impacts in fixed income from rising interest rates
COST MANAGEMENT - Lower SG&A expenses, including reduced employee compensation and sub-advisory fees, helped offset weaker revenue
